title: Inverse problem for the divisor of the good Boussinesq equation
summary: A third-order operator with periodic coefficients is an L-operator in the Lax pair for the Boussinesq equation on a circle. The projection of the divisor of the Floquet solution poles for this operator coincides with the spectrum of the three-point Dirichlet problem. The sign of the norming constant of the three-point problem determines the sheet of the Riemann surface on which the pole lies. We solve the inverse problem for a third-order operator with three-point Dirichlet conditions when the spectrum and norming constant are known.
